description: Use this function to create a new host in openITCOCKPIT. container_name defaults to the root container if not given; hosttemplate_name defaults to the built-in 'default host' template. hosttemplate_name must be visible from container_name's scope - use get_allowed_elements_for_container(object_type="host", container_name=...) to see which host templates qualify.

container_name.description: Target container path. Empty means the root container.

name: create_host
title: Create Host
